title: Climb plan: Masters 450 to Challenger
basis: First principles and arithmetic, no win-rate data. Written as a coaching plan for Noah: Bronze to Masters 450 LP one rank per season (Darius top to D1, Kog'Maw ADC to Masters 450), decayed to low Diamond 4.

ladder.note: Assumptions for the arithmetic only. Low D4 to Masters 0 is about 400 LP; the NA Challenger cutoff moves during the season and sits several hundred LP above Masters 0, so 1,000 LP total is a round illustration. Real gains depend on MMR.

variance.method: Monte Carlo, 200,000 simulated runs of independent games at a true 55% win rate.

pace.note: Noah's answer: 10 to 25 ranked games a week, with a death note every game and two VOD reviews a week.
